meta.name: chrome-history
meta.description: Query Chrome browsing history with natural language. Filter by date range, article type, keywords, and specific sites.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言从Chrome历史中快速找到想看的内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想通过提问快速定位曾经访问过的网页
copy.tagline_en: Quickly find what you want from Chrome history using natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly locate previously visited pages by asking a question

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过自然语言查询你的 Chrome 浏览历史。你可以按日期、内容类型、关键词或网站筛选，它会返回带链接的分组结果（如阅读、研究等）。
howto.when: 当你询问关于浏览历史的问题，比如“昨天看了哪些文章”或“上周访问过的科研网页”时，技能自动查询 Chrome 数据库并返回结果。

say.note: 返回昨天浏览的阅读类网页

say.text: 上周访问的科学研究网页
这个月逛过的 Reddit 帖子

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query your Chrome browsing history using natural language. You can filter by date, content type, keywords, or website. It returns grouped results with links (e.g., reading, research).
howto.when_en: When you ask about browsing history, e.g., 'articles I read yesterday' or 'research pages visited last week', this skill automatically queries the Chrome database and returns results.

say_en.text: What articles did I read yesterday?
Show me scientific pages from last week
List Reddit threads I visited this month
